analyses.result_scope: C1 stage-resolved reward-to-memory mechanism plus the current frozen zero-call CBRG extension
source_refs: repo://Obsidian/Papers/C1 - Reward Errors Change Memory Before Policy.md
estimands: same-trajectory success-vs-failure writer intervention effect on durable memory state
stagewise transport of branch-specific state through retrieval exposure, first-action uptake, and terminal outcome
operational branch-contrast auditability versus semantic evidence validity and actionable authority

observed.statement: Reward-conditioned writing is robust under the frozen same-trajectory intervention.
observed.evidence: Shopping write diverges for 20/20 success/failure pairs; the combined frozen D0 lineage has 24/24 same pre-writer trajectory projections, same resolved writer model within pair, temperature 0, and different branch-memory content.

observed.statement: The writer-mode effect is larger than a stronger same-mode wording perturbation in the archived F0C control.
observed.evidence: Mean between-minus-within distance is 0.104978 with exact one-sided sign-flip p=0.007812 over the frozen eight-task control.

observed.statement: A large write difference does not reliably propagate through native downstream behavior.
observed.evidence: Forced injection terminal |Delta|=0.15625 passes the frozen 0.15 practical floor, while native Shopping terminal |S-F|=0.02083 with 34/36 zero; first-action TV=0.06944 with 0/36 modal branch-action differences; Reddit native terminal |S-F|=0.125 with 6/8 zero and opposite signs in the two nonzero cells.

observed.statement: Operational branch differences are reproducibly compilable and mostly locatable in pre-writer evidence.
observed.evidence: 423/423 directional same-field branch-contrast units compile; 397/423 have a nonzero exact lexical anchor across 58,230 frozen pre-writer browser-state lines; 26/423 remain unlocated.

observed.statement: Evidence location did not establish evidence validity or branch authority.
observed.evidence: Semantic validity remains 0/423 and nonzero branch authority remains 0. The local stack has 0 qualified semantic adjudicators and 0 C1 semantic qualification receipts; the bounded repository inventory also finds 0 external executable adjudicator candidates and 0 external semantic qualification receipts.

positive_implications: The scientifically stable object is the stage-resolved intervention chain, not a generic correlation between reward and memory. A terminal label can causally select a different writer branch on the same trajectory at the intervention level.

Operational paired branch contrast is a legitimate measurable object even when atom-level causal purity is not certified; useful measurement objects need not be discarded merely because stronger causal language is unavailable.
The write-to-behavior attenuation itself is informative: persistent-state mutation and behavioral authority are separate stages that require separate measurements.
negative_boundaries: The current data do not certify each textual Title/Description/Content delta atom as a pure causal effect because explicit decoding seeds or same-condition same-trajectory noise-floor replications are absent.
397/423 locator coverage is auditability, not semantic support. Lexical or embedding similarity cannot be promoted to SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED evidence states.
No CBRG behavioral improvement has been measured because the provider method experiment never received scientific execution authority.

Absence of a qualified local/repository adjudicator does not prove that evidence-gated residual authority is globally impossible; it only closes the current frozen extension under its preregistered qualification contract.

strongest_alternative_explanations.alternative: Generic prompt wording rather than reward/reflection mode explains the memory difference.
strongest_alternative_explanations.disposition: Weakened by the same-mode wording control: the between-mode effect exceeds the stronger within-mode wording perturbation, but atom-level stochastic purity remains unresolved.

strongest_alternative_explanations.alternative: Large memory divergence necessarily implies downstream policy divergence.
strongest_alternative_explanations.disposition: Contradicted by stagewise evidence: forced leverage exists, but native first-action and terminal transport are sparse and heterogeneous.

strongest_alternative_explanations.alternative: Semantic similarity or exact lexical location is sufficient evidence authority.
strongest_alternative_explanations.disposition: Rejected as a category error: locator/applicability can prioritize inspection but cannot distinguish support from contradiction and therefore cannot grant branch authority.

strongest_alternative_explanations.alternative: The CBRG STOP is evidence that the core C1 scientific phenomenon failed.
strongest_alternative_explanations.disposition: Rejected. The STOP occurs before a method-effect experiment at the method-realization/qualification layer and leaves independently measured stage-resolved evidence intact.

analysis.mechanism_interpretation: Reward-conditioned memory construction is a strong upstream state intervention whose behavioral influence is filtered by later exposure and uptake stages. The correct causal/mechanistic object is therefore a transport chain with stage-specific attenuation, not a one-step reward->behavior story. Evidence authority adds another distinct layer: a branch-specific statement can be locatable and applicable without being independently validated.
analysis.failure_diagnosis: CBRG requires an outcome-independent semantic-validity adjudicator before any residual receives actionable authority. Under the frozen zero-call support, no independently qualified adjudicator or qualification receipt exists. Inventing one after observing this gate failure would create post-outcome self-validation. The current extension therefore stops at method realization rather than failing a behavioral effect test.
analysis.does_not_imply: CBRG method-effect failure, C1 phenomenon failure, invalidation of the write/exposure/uptake/outcome measurements, or a global impossibility theorem for evidence-gated memory authority
analysis.paper_implication: Use the stage-resolved identification/measurement archetype as the active C1 paper story. Make the main contribution the separation of durable write divergence from native behavioral transport, supported by forced leverage, exposure, first-action localization, terminal boundaries, and cross-domain heterogeneity. Keep CBRG as internal negative method-development evidence rather than a claimed solution.
analysis.next_scientific_action: Paper-only strengthening on the frozen evidence base: build the stage-resolved boundary figure, rewrite the Introduction/claim hierarchy around memory-divergence-versus-behavioral-authority, and preserve the exact negative boundaries. Do not run a CBRG provider experiment unless the four-part reopen contract is independently satisfied.

failure_asset.reusable_precheck: Before a method gates treatment-specific residual content, freeze the validity semantics and independently qualify the evidence adjudicator on pre-outcome support. Locator coverage, semantic similarity, the treatment label, terminal reward, and downstream outcome cannot validate the residual. If no qualified signal exists, STOP/MERGE the current method extension rather than inventing a post-outcome verifier; preserve any independently valid measurement/mechanism result.
failure_asset.does_not_imply: method-effect failure, core-principle failure, measurement invalidity, or global impossibility of evidence-gated authority

discovery_lessons.title: Persistent-state divergence is not downstream behavioral authority
discovery_lessons.summary: A controlled update can robustly change durable memory while native behavioral transport is sparse. Measure write, exposure, policy uptake, and outcome separately; do not infer downstream control from state distance alone.
source_refs: repo://Obsidian/Papers/C1 - Reward Errors Change Memory Before Policy.md
discovery_lessons.reopen_condition: A future claim may collapse the stages only if a preregistered intervention shows stable monotone transport from the persistent-state change through exposure and action uptake to held-out outcomes under matched evidence and budget.
discovery_lessons.reusable_precheck: For every persistent update experiment, report at least one state-change metric and one downstream uptake/outcome metric, and localize the first stage where the treatment effect attenuates or changes sign.
discovery_lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for updates with matched durable-state divergence but different exposure/uptake transport, or matched exposure with different action uptake, to identify the missing transport variable.

discovery_lessons.title: Evidence location, semantic validity, and behavioral authority are distinct gates
discovery_lessons.summary: Finding an exact source span or high-similarity anchor only makes a claim auditable. It does not establish support versus contradiction and cannot grant treatment-specific behavioral authority without a separately qualified outcome-independent adjudicator.
discovery_lessons.reopen_condition: Collapse locator and validity only if an independently frozen rule proves that the locator deterministically entails the required support/contradiction semantics on the target scientific object; similarity alone is insufficient.
discovery_lessons.reusable_precheck: When evidence controls an update, implement three explicit states: located/unlocated, semantically supported/contradicted/unverifiable, and authority granted/withheld. Test and receipt them separately.
discovery_lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for cases with equally strong evidence anchors but opposite semantic validity, or equally supported claims with different downstream authority consequences.

discovery_lessons.title: Qualification/support STOP is not a method-effect or scientific failure
discovery_lessons.summary: If a proposed method cannot independently qualify a required validity signal before execution, the current realization should STOP/MERGE without fabricating a verifier. This blocks the method experiment but does not falsify an unrun method effect or independently established phenomenon/mechanism evidence.
discovery_lessons.reopen_condition: Reopen only with new content-addressed qualification evidence that existed independently of the terminal outcome, plus the original same-information non-reducibility and collision gates; a renamed baseline or generic model checkpoint is not enough.
discovery_lessons.reusable_precheck: Before interpreting any STOP, name the exact failure layer and whether the claimed treatment was actually executed. Never translate execution/support/qualification failure into method-effect failure or core-principle failure.
discovery_lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for methods whose required validity signal is independently observable and qualified before method evaluation, so behavioral effect can be tested without self-validation.

paper_guidance.active_story: reward-label intervention -> durable write divergence -> forced leverage -> native transport boundary -> first-action uptake localization -> cross-domain heterogeneity -> evaluation/design implication
paper_guidance.load_bearing_message: Memory divergence is not behavioral divergence, and branch-specific memory content is not validated behavioral authority.
required_paper_only_actions: Add a main-text stage-resolved boundary figure with write, retrieval exposure, first-action uptake, forced terminal leverage, native Shopping terminal, Reddit terminal, and outcome-blind control.
Rewrite Introduction and contribution hierarchy around the scientific mismeasurement: endpoint or memory-state metrics conflate distinct propagation stages.
State the operational-contrast versus atom-level-causal-purity boundary explicitly and keep 0/423 semantic-validity/authority facts visible.
Treat CBRG as stopped method-development evidence, not as a verified solution or a missing experiment to be rescued.
forbidden_rescue_moves: invent a semantic verifier after observing the D0-B2 hold
promote lexical or embedding similarity to semantic validity
increase rollout depth or select positive cells to force a method story
interpret missing qualification infrastructure as proof that C1 or all evidence-gating methods fail
